name: MedStation
verdict: MedStation spent $142.84 on Meta over 28 days and generated zero tracked leads, triggering a lead drought flag despite 294 clicks and the top retargeting campaign ("WARM-RETARGETING") consuming $59.01. The most alarming movement is a 44.44% drop in Google Business Profile actions over the last 7 days, compounding the conversion problem at a time when ad spend surged 120.63% week-over-week, suggesting the landing experience or form is likely breaking the conversion path.

performance.verdict: Spend is live but zero leads in 28 days; 9 overdue milestones explain why.

findings.text: Zero leads from $142.84 Meta spend over 28 days — 294 clicks with 0 GA4 conversions confirms a broken conversion path, not an audience problem.
5 SOW milestones were due 2026-07-31 (stack test, GHL migration, GBP triage, Meta account/CAPI, landing pages/tracking) — all overdue 45+ days; these are the structural cause of F1.
4 further SOW milestones due 2026-08-31 to 2026-09-01 (Meta lanes live, Search campaigns, LSA verification, nurture sequences) are also overdue as of today, 2026-09-14.
GBP actions fell 44.44% (7d vs prior 7d); last 3 days show 0 actions vs a prior-3-day average of ~1 — organic local intent is collapsing coincident with ad spend ramping to $18.06 on 2026-09-13.
GA4 sessions dropped 12.15% week-over-week; last 3 days (Sep 11–13) averaged 89 vs prior 3 days (Sep 8–10) averaging 158 — a 44% 3-day decline despite $36.56 spend in that window.

suggestions.text: Immediately audit landing page and form tracking — $142.84 spent, 0 leads, 294 clicks; fix conversion path before any further spend.
suggestions.monday_update: The Meta campaigns have delivered 294 clicks and $142.84 in spend over 28 days with zero recorded leads or GA4 conversions — the conversion path is broken. The pre-launch stack test (due 2026-07-31) and landing page/tracking milestone (also due 2026-07-31) were never completed, which is the confirmed cause. Nacer to run the end-to-end stack test this week: simulate a form submission from each live ad → confirm it enters GHL → appears in reporting. Success check: at least 1 verified test lead recorded in GHL and GA4 by 2026-09-17.

suggestions.text: Watch Meta spend at current $14.04/day ceiling — do not scale until F1 conversion path is confirmed fixed.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta is spending ~$14.04/day with zero lead output; scaling now would compound the loss with no signal of return. Hold all budgets at current levels until the landing page and tracking fix (S1) is verified. Re-check on 2026-09-17: if at least 1 tracked lead is confirmed in GHL post-fix, escalate to Sohib for a scaling conversation. No budget move executes without that confirmation.

suggestions.text: Escalate 9 overdue SOW milestones to Sohib and Nacer — 45+ days past due; Phase 1 cannot be evaluated without them.
suggestions.monday_update: Nine SOW milestones across Ops, CRM, Meta, Google Search, and Web/SEO departments remain undelivered as of 2026-09-14, with the oldest 45+ days overdue (originally due 2026-07-31). Without these — particularly Meta CAPI, GHL migration, and the stack test — no lead can be reliably tracked and no Phase 1 performance judgment can be made. Sohib to convene a milestone review with Nacer by 2026-09-16 and produce a revised delivery date for each item. Success check: written revised dates confirmed by all dept leads by 2026-09-18.
